definitions: A conceptual framework or perspective used to evaluate decisions, strategies, or events based on their potential impact over different periods of time.
A tool for analyzing the short-term, medium-term, and long-term implications of a particular action or situation.
examples: Applying a time horizon lens revealed the long-term benefits of the investment.
The project manager used a time horizon lens to assess risks.
Understanding the problem through a time horizon lens helped in strategic planning.
